productName: Rainbow AI — FnB AI Waiter Enhancement
overview: End-to-end AI waiter integration: rainbow-ai makan-moments profile handles customer chat from fnb-online-ordering, acting as MCP client to query live menu data and place orders in the fnb-online-ordering system. Customers at localhost:3031/en can chat with the AI waiter, ask about the menu, and place pre-orders — all powered by rainbow-ai's makan-moments profile calling back to fnb-online-ordering's MCP server.
goals: Add /api/fnb/chat SSE endpoint in rainbow-ai so the fnb-online-ordering proxy can connect
Add FnB MCP client tools in rainbow-ai (menu browsing, order creation, order status)
Register FnB tools for makan-moments profile only, not hostel profiles
Configure makan-moments profile to use FnB tools when answering customer questions
Fix and verify end-to-end: customer chat → rainbow-ai → MCP call → live fnb data
Enhance fnb-online-ordering chat UI with order-aware quick replies and better UX

userStories.title: Add /api/fnb/chat SSE streaming endpoint in rainbow-ai
userStories.description: The fnb-online-ordering proxy at /api/chat/rainbow calls RAINBOW_AI_URL/api/fnb/chat but this endpoint does not exist in rainbow-ai yet. Create a POST /api/fnb/chat route that: accepts { messages: [{id,role,content,parts}] } (UIMessage array from Vercel AI SDK), routes to the makan-moments profile via profileRegistry, streams SSE events in format {"type":"text","text":"..."} terminated with [DONE], and uses the existing processChat / chat-engine. Also accept the simpler { message: string, history: [], sessionId? } format for backwards compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: POST http://localhost:3002/api/fnb/chat with {"messages":[{"id":"1","role":"user","content":"hello","parts":[{"type":"text","text":"hello"}]}]} returns SSE stream
SSE events are in format: data: {"type":"text","text":"..."}\n\n
Stream ends with data: [DONE]\n\n
Uses makan-moments profile (not pelangi or southern)
Also accepts legacy { message: string, history: [] } format and converts to UIMessage[]
Rate limited to 10 req/min per IP (reuse webchat limiter)
TypeScript compiles without errors
technicalNotes: Add the route in src/routes/public/webchat-api.ts or a new src/routes/public/fnb-chat.ts
Mount at app.use('/api/fnb', fnbChatRoutes) in src/index.ts
Reuse profileRegistry.getProfile('makan-moments') and the existing processChat function from chat-engine.ts
SSE format must match what fnb-online-ordering/src/app/api/chat/rainbow/route.ts expects: it reads data: lines, parses JSON, looks for parsed.type === 'text' && parsed.text
For streaming: use res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/event-stream'), write chunks as they come from the LLM
If processChat does not stream natively, call it and write the full response as a single SSE event
Add FNB_CHAT_RATE_LIMIT env var (default 10) for configurable rate limit

userStories.title: Add FnB MCP client tools for menu browsing in rainbow-ai
userStories.description: Create src/tools/fnb-menu.ts with MCP client tools that call fnb-online-ordering's /api/mcp endpoint. These tools let rainbow-ai's makan-moments profile fetch live menu data when customers ask questions. Tools: fnb_get_menu (full menu, filterable by category), fnb_get_menu_item (single item by code), fnb_get_categories (category list), fnb_get_cafe_info (hours, address, WiFi, FAQ). The FnB MCP endpoint is at FNB_MCP_URL env var (default http://localhost:3031/api/mcp). Public tools don't need auth; admin tools need x-mcp-secret header.

fnb_get_menu_item calls with {"tool":"fnb_get_menu_item","input":{"code":"..."}}}
fnb_get_categories and fnb_get_cafe_info implemented similarly
FNB_MCP_URL defaults to http://localhost:3031/api/mcp if not set
Tools handle network errors gracefully (return error message, don't throw)
TypeScript compiles without errors
technicalNotes: File: src/tools/fnb-menu.ts

The fnb /api/mcp endpoint accepts POST with body: {tool: string, input: object} and optionally x-mcp-secret header
Use node fetch (already available) to call the endpoint
Each tool handler should: fetch the endpoint, return the result.content or result text

userStories.title: Add FnB MCP client tools for order management in rainbow-ai
userStories.description: Create src/tools/fnb-orders.ts with order management tools. Public tools (no auth): fnb_create_order (create a new pre-order for a customer — requires items array, customer phone, estimated arrival time), fnb_get_order_status (check order status by order ID — public, customer-facing), fnb_get_operating_hours (check if cafe is currently open). Admin tools (need FNB_MCP_SECRET): fnb_get_pending_orders (list pending orders for staff review), fnb_approve_order (approve an order), fnb_update_order_status (update status).

fnb_get_order_status takes orderId string, returns status + items
fnb_get_operating_hours returns whether cafe is open now and today's hours
Admin tools include x-mcp-secret header from FNB_MCP_SECRET env var
Tools return friendly error messages on network failure
